scientific_integrity: Algebraic specialization, finite exhaustive certificate, and explicit dependence on a cited geometric classification; no claim of independent verification or uniqueness of discovery.
scientific_limitations: The published geometric total of 40 lines and 9 A1 nodes is used for geometric completeness; only the arithmetic splitting and marked incidence are new. The nonreduced Fano scheme and surface zeta function are not determined; specialist tables might contain equivalent arithmetic information.
title: Complete rational splitting and incidence at the nine-node degeneration of a characteristic-three quartic
